agents.name: architect
agents.description: GPT-6 Luna (high reasoning) for multi-file architecture and bugs that persist after repeated failed checks. Read-only advice.

agents.name: reviewer
agents.description: GPT-6 Luna for an independent second opinion on a design or a diff. Read-only.

agents.name: worker
agents.description: GPT-6 Luna coding worker for careful reasoning and refactors. Read-only; returns code for the caller to apply.

agents.name: pr_writer
agents.description: Writes PR.md for the current git branch, with a new branch name, commit message, PR title, and PR body. Reads git only; never commits or pushes.
